docs.summary: Fluent builder for an Origami foldout. Construct via [`Foldout`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~Foldout); chain modifiers; call [`Body`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.FoldoutBuilder~Body) to render.
docs.remarks:
Layout when expanded:
- Header — top-rounded only, fills the foldout's row width, hosts the chevron / toggle / label / badge.
- Body wrapper — bottom-rounded, same surface tone as the header (extends visually). Wraps the inner content panel and a vertical scroll if needed.
- Inner content panel — sits inside the body wrapper with margin and its own rounded outline; uses a darker fill so it reads as a recessed inset where actual content lives.

docs.summary: First-time expansion state. After the first frame, user expand state persists in element storage.

members.name: Expanded
members.signature: public FoldoutBuilder Expanded(bool value, Action<bool> onChanged)

docs.summary: Controlled expansion: the caller owns the open state. Overrides the internal storage so the foldout renders exactly `value`; `onChanged` fires with the requested state when the header is clicked. Use this for accordions (single-open groups).

members.name: Toggle
members.signature: public FoldoutBuilder Toggle(bool value, Action<bool> setter)

docs.summary: Add an enable toggle next to the header chevron. The label dims when `value` is false; `setter` fires on click.
Right-aligned text on the header — use for counts, summaries, status indicators.

Optional leading vector icon, drawn between the caret and the label. The stroke color is preset to the acc-300 accent (`theme.Primary.C700`); the action receives the icon's canvas and bounds — draw a path and `Stroke()` (or override the stroke color yourself).
Render the foldout. `drawContents` only runs when expanded.
